services.name: Ice Fishing
services.desc: Are you looking for an exciting winter adventure? If so, you won’t want to miss the opportunity to try ice fishing on Lake Minnetonka. Located just outside the Twin Cities, Lake Minnetonka offers some of the best ice fishing in the region. But ice fishing on Lake Minnetonka isn’t just about the fishing. It’s also a chance to experience the beauty of winter in Minnesota. With its snow-covered shoreline and frozen expanses of water, Lake Minnetonka is a picturesque winter wonderland. To make the most of your Lake Minnetonka ice fishing adventure, it’s important to hire the right guide that has all the equipment. Jasper Guide Services has everything you will need, an ice auger to drill holes
